name: sample/critique — draft, judge, repeat (control edge)
description: The retry loop: 'act' drafts, 'critic' judges (active evaluator heuristic first, then one LLM-with-schema call), and a CONTROL edge feeds the verdict back to 'act'. Data edges must be acyclic — the only legal cycle is a declared control edge leaving a verdict node (critic/gate), and it MUST carry max_passes, so the loop terminates by construction. Here: at most 3 judge passes.

config.text: You are a careful writer who takes critique seriously: address every gap the critic names, then stop.

config.task: Write a complete, well-structured answer to the goal. Expect one or two critique passes — revise the draft to close each named gap.
